p2_46: Power comes from the 3.0L Duramax turbo-diesel with a 10-speed automatic transmission. It is rated to tow up to 9,000 lbs. Original MSRP was $65,890. At $41,474, this represents $24,416 in depreciation the next buyer does not absorb. The RST sits above the LT in Chevrolet's lineup and brings body-color bumpers, black bowtie emblems, LED fog lamps, a 13.4-inch touchscreen with Google built-in, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a 12.3-inch digital driver information display, heated front seats, heated steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, 10-way power driver seat, and remote start as standard equipment. This truck adds the Z71 Off-Road Package ($750), which upgrades the suspension with twin-tube shocks, adds skid plates for underbody protection, brings hill descent control for controlled low-speed descents off pavement, and equips a two-speed Autotrac transfer case for on-demand four-wheel-drive engagement. The Convenience Package II ($1,340) layers in a Bose 7-speaker premium audio system, a power sliding rear window with rear defogger, the in-vehicle trailering app, universal home remote, integrated trailer brake controller, and hitch guidance with hitch view. The 20-inch high-gloss black painted aluminum wheels ($1,100) replace the trim's standard finish wheels with a blacked-out look that suits the RST's sport aesthetic. Assist steps ($950) provide a secure textured step for easy cab entry. The Protection Package ($685) adds a ChevyTec spray-on bedliner and rear wheelhouse liners to guard the cargo area and inner fenders. The MultiFlex tailgate ($445) opens in multiple configurations, including an inner fold-down panel that doubles as a step or work surface. The Dark Essentials Package ($420) swaps chrome exterior badges for black nameplates. Front bucket seats with center console ($620) replace the standard bench with individual seats and a floor-mounted console for a more driver-focused feel. All-terrain tires, all-weather floor liners, a rear sliding power window, trailer brake controller, hitch guidance with hitch view, skid plates, hill descent control, heavy-duty air filter, integrated dual exhaust, and a universal home remote round out the build. Current asking price is $41,474 (includes $899 dealer administrative fee), $8,175 below J.D. Power Typical Listing Price and $1,181 below active listings across the Southeast for comparable units. The powertrain warranty runs through January 1, 2034 or 100,000 odometer miles, whichever comes first. The High-Tech Warranty adds 12 months or 12,000 miles of coverage from the date of purchase.
